XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay Academy - Email template management tables

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_email_overrides
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-tenant email template overrides. DB rows take precedence over Mustache files.

FIELD.NAME: tenant_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Costcenter ID: 0=global, 1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA

FIELD.NAME: template_key
FIELD.COMMENT: Template path e.g. compliance/deadline_warning

FIELD.NAME: subject
FIELD.COMMENT: Override subject line. NULL = use default from Mustache.

FIELD.NAME: body_html
FIELD.COMMENT: Override HTML body with Mustache placeholders. NULL = use file.

FIELD.NAME: body_text
FIELD.COMMENT: Override plain text body. NULL = auto-generate from HTML.

FIELD.NAME: is_active
FIELD.COMMENT: 1=active, 0=disabled (falls through to next in chain)

INDEX.NAME: uix_tenant_template
INDEX.COMMENT: One override per tenant per template

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_email_rules
TABLE.COMMENT: Smart notification rules with trigger conditions and channel config.

FIELD.NAME: rule_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable rule name

FIELD.NAME: rule_type
FIELD.COMMENT: deadline_approaching, course_not_started, streak_broken, manager_nudge, new_course, compliance_enrolled, compliance_overdue, weekly_escalation, custom

FIELD.NAME: trigger_event
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle event class or cron for scheduled evaluation

FIELD.NAME: trigger_days
FIELD.COMMENT: Days before/after event to fire. Negative = before, positive = after.

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: email, popup, teams, push, all

FIELD.NAME: audience
FIELD.COMMENT: learner, manager, admin, all

FIELD.NAME: template_key
FIELD.COMMENT: Points to email template e.g. compliance/overdue_alert

FIELD.NAME: tenant_id
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=all tenants, or specific costcenter ID

FIELD.NAME: priority
FIELD.COMMENT: 1-100, higher = more important

FIELD.NAME: conditions_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON for advanced filters: course IDs, min/max progress, etc.

FIELD.NAME: cadence_days_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Sprint B: JSON array of day offsets for ramping cadence, e.g. [1,3,7,14,21]. Used by course_incomplete rule type.

FIELD.NAME: max_reminders_per_user
FIELD.COMMENT: Sprint B: cap per (user, course). 0 = unlimited.

FIELD.NAME: auto_stop_on_completion
FIELD.COMMENT: Sprint B: 1=suppress reminders once user completes course.

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_email_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Unified delivery log for all Airpay-originated notifications.

FIELD.NAME: rule_id
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to email_rules. NULL for ad-hoc sends.

FIELD.NAME: legacy_type
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS notification type shortname for cross-reference

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: sent, failed, bounced, suppressed, suppressed_completion

FIELD.NAME: attachment_filename
FIELD.COMMENT: Sprint B: name of any attached file (e.g. 'certificate.pdf'). NULL when no attachment was sent.

FIELD.NAME: certificate_issue_id
FIELD.COMMENT: Sprint B: FK to tool_certificate_issues.id when this delivery carried a course-completion certificate PDF.

FIELD.NAME: rule_type
FIELD.COMMENT: Matches email_rules.rule_type or all for global pref

INDEX.NAME: uix_user_ruletype
INDEX.COMMENT: One preference per user per rule type
